notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
After a pause in development for personal reasons, development continues as usual.

Current work centers on the new procedural narrative/storyteller system. This system will generate procedural and interconnected events that will generate a unique story for each playthrough. For the demo version that is planned for release in June, a few event types will be available.
Two of the computer players AI is also already implemented but requires further tweaking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015317/c11dee4f39f395c99947618ce604c15bd3247f50.png[/img]

notes.title: Game development update
notes.content:
Hello,
To offer a more complete game experience for the demo launch, it is postponed to November. 
However, before that, the early alpha testing phase will be initiated the same month. 

The multiverse exploration part is mostly functional, but the number of FTL travel methods implemented for alpha/demo will be 2 or 3.
The development is finishing the research/tech system and patching/hardening all systems. Here is a video demonstration of the unoptimized battle system handling +800 spaceships simultaneously in combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015317/9d4fbe051871837bc1a2925ab3f914c9f522aa13.png[/img]

[previewyoutube=Sy6hy_MUvRw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ground combat system development.
notes.content:
In HARD VOID space and ground combat play simultaneously and seamlessly. Ground units will be custom-designed in the same way as ships. Ground units will consist of:
[list]
[*] Infantry
[*] Armored Vehicles (Tanks, rocket launchers, etc)
[*] Mechs (various types)
[*] Sea ships and submarines (when oceans are available)
[*] Fighters and bombers airplanes.
[/list]

Spaceships with deployment modules can carry and deploy units in Astros.

[previewyoutube=zYVcWbgo4c4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Colony and economy update
notes.content:
Update on the economic, management and exploration aspects of the game.
The game is set in a procedural multiverse, standard C-class universes (like ours) and subspace S-class universes (more universe classes will be added later).

[list]
[*] Multiverse generation is up and running.
[*] Astro characteristics are implemented.
[*] Colony bases production and management mechanics are mostly implemented.
[/list]
